# AT-Switch v3.16.1

发布日期 / Release date: 2026-10-12

## 本次更新

- 统一接入 TRAE CN 3.4.2，通过原生模型服务同步 Agent 与 IDE 的实际模型选择。
- 支持单 IDE 工作区的 Direct 模式：OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses 和 Anthropic Messages。
- 首次连接可能正常退出并启动一次 TRAE；建立会话后，后续切换与恢复不再重启。
- 保留 Provider、凭据、用户模型和其他智能体配置，并支持恢复首次接管前的选择。
- 仅支持 TRAE CN 3.4.2。旧版 TraeCode / TraeWork 客户端、Proxy 模式和多个独立 IDE 工作区不在支持范围。

## Changes

- Add one unified TRAE integration for TRAE CN 3.4.2 and synchronize actual model selection in the Agent and IDE.
- Support Direct mode with OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages for one IDE workspace.
- The first connection may restart TRAE once; later switches and restoration reuse the established session without another restart.
- Preserve providers, credentials, user models, and other agent settings, with restoration to the selection from before AT-Switch first took over.
- TRAE CN 3.4.2 only. Legacy TraeCode / TraeWork clients, Proxy mode, and multiple independent IDE workspaces are unsupported.

## 验收边界 / Validation notes

TRAE Proxy、多个独立 IDE 工作区、真实 Provider 推理、Streaming 和 Tool Calling 不属于本次已验证范围。Local mock tests verify configuration, selection, and restoration behavior; actual API access depends on provider permissions and model capabilities.
